prompt: a pressure-plate puzzle temple with crumbling floors

intent.setting: A crumbling pressure-plate temple with collapsing floors
intent.role: Treasure hunter or adventurer facing environmental traps
intent.goal: Navigate the temple by stepping on the correct sequence of pressure plates to open the exit and secure the treasure before the floor collapses.
intent.fail: Triggering a disarming sequence, stepping on an incorrect plate, or falling into a cracked void, allowing the temple to seal permanently.
intent.headline: Navigating pressure plates requires precise sequencing before floors crumble
